description: Implicit memory-read scenarios. Positive cases: the question/task depends on the user's/project's persisted facts — the engram skill must fire a search (memory_search or CLI search) BEFORE answering, and the answer must be grounded in seeded store content (empty store => honest not-found, no invention). Negative cases: questions unrelated to any persisted fact — no engram call may occur. Seeds are planted deterministically via CLI before the prompt runs; judge anchors are engram operation traces plus answer-text content checks. v2: bilingual seed content (offline keyword retrieval is language-sensitive; seeds carry both zh and en keywords).
